entry.title: ERANTHEUMUJ
entry.text: ERANTHEUMUJ, in botany; a genus of the diandria, menogyalda. The coloris its divided into five tag- ments if the tribe is filomn y and the flagan is limple. There is but one facies, a native of Ethiopia.
